objective: saves_per_reach: Create a seven-day Deepavali campaign for Poojaloka's diyas, brass items and pooja essentials across Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest and Threads, aimed at families in Bengaluru.
audience: Families in Bengaluru and across Karnataka preparing for daily pooja and festivals; people setting up a first home altar. (Suggested from the catalogue and site; confirm with real customer data.)
headline: Meet our Brass Pooja Petti
tagline: From the Brass Collection range at Poojaloka
required_text: From the Brass Collection range at Poojaloka
banned: prices, MRP, discounts, offers, sale or coupon wording
purity, origin, authenticity, health or spiritual-benefit claims
deity imagery, religious figures, mantras or Sanskrit text
stock photos presented as the product
competitor names, text, layouts or imagery
“Own delivery in Bengaluru” (restricted: needs owner sign-off)
canva_query: Design a 1080×1350 (4:5 portrait) Instagram post for Poojaloka. Layout: centred stack: headline, tagline, CTA, wordmark at the foot. Colours #2B1810, #C99A3D, #6B1420; mood: warm, respectful and uncluttered. Text, exactly as written: "Meet our Brass Pooja Petti", "From the Brass Collection range at Poojaloka", "Tap the link in bio", "Poojaloka". Use exactly the quoted text and add no other words, numbers, prices, offers or claims. Typographic only: no product photos, stock photos, deities, religious figures, mantras or Sanskrit text.

signals.reason: text only slot in the weekly mix; angle product spotlight; 1 supporting research signal(s); general post pattern seen in 3 competitor reference(s), not copied; Product showcase posts averaged 2.4% engagement (n=6); demo data
